==Description==
The '''Swordmaster''' was the first, and only, boss in [[The Heights]]. It walked very slowly, but had lots of health; more than the [[Molten Boss]] before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], with three abilities. Upon its death, if the mode was Normal+, all players were rewarded with the [[Gladiator]].

It had three abilities:
#The first ability involved the '''Swordmaster''' swinging its sword in a full rotation, stunning all towers hit by the sword.
#The next ability was quite similar, smashing its sword into the ground stunning all ground towers within a radius.
#Its third and final ability involved the '''Swordmaster''' pointing its sword forwards and spawning random [[enemies]], in a random amount, at the start of the map. These random enemies could be the [[Fallen Hero (The Heights)|Fallen Hero]], the [[Slow Boss]], the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], the [[Stone Viking]], the [[Brute (The Heights)|Brute]] or the [[Slow]].

==Appearance==
The '''Swordmaster''' wore a red cloak and pants. Painted on its cloak appeared to be a necklace. It had green skin, light red legs and a dark red shirt. It had several pouches on its belt and wore a yellow crown. It wielded a Darkheart sword by its right side. It had red glowing eyes and had a drooling zombie face.

==Strategy==
*You can use the [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability to stop the '''Swordmaster'''. This gives you much more time to defeat the boss.
**You can sell and re-buy the [[Freezer]] quickly to use the ability again. Do be aware that it is quite expensive.
*[[Pyromancer]]s can burn the '''Swordmaster''', slowing it down.
*Support towers, such as the [[Militant|John]] and [[Commander]], are a given due to your tight budget.
**This means that you should spam cheap high DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], around these support towers.
**The [[Ranger|Outlaw]] can also be effective, though do be aware of its high cost.
*Relocate your towers whenever the '''Swordmaster''' is out of range so that you can maximize damage.
**However, it may be ideal to keep some towers near the start of the map to deal with the [[enemies]] that the '''Swordmaster''' spawns.

==Trivia==
*The [[Fallen Swordmaster]] is the resurrected version of the '''Swordmaster''', as stated by a [https://twitter.com/BelowNatural/status/1229276487607627776 tweet].
*The crown that the '''Swordmaster''' wore was the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/1081300/Golden-Crown Golden Crown] hat from the Roblox catalog.
*The '''Swordmaster''' was the first major boss to be added to the game, predating even the [[Molten Boss]].
*The '''Swordmaster's''' appearance was based on an outfit that [https://www.roblox.com/users/261/profile Shedletsky]/[https://www.roblox.com/users/13645/profile Telamon] used to wear.
**Shedletsky is the creator of [https://www.roblox.com/games/47324/Sword-Fights-on-the-Heights-IV Sword Fights on the Heights IV], which [[The Heights]] was based on.
*Upon release, the '''Swordmaster''' used to damage the base health for every tower that it stunned, with any of its abilities. This could lead to you losing if the base health reached 0.
**Therefore, this was the first enemy that was able to damage the base with an ability, but it was removed shortly after its addition.

==Update History==
*'''24 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.2|BETA v1.2.0]]
**'''Swordmaster''' added.
*'''24 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.2|BETA v1.2.0a]]
**Stuns can no longer deal damage to the base health.
*'''13 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.9|BETA v1.9.2]]
**Base health decreased from 50,000 to 45,000.
*'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]]
**'''Swordmaster''' removed.
